dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Bubbles is at risk due to behavior concerns. Bubble is noted to frequently attempts to bite and tug the leash, with staff reporting increased intensity and episodes where redirection is unsuccessful. He also fixates and pulls intensely toward neighboring dogs, at times nearly causing himself to pass out, and may kennel fight. Bubbles is noted to be social with handlers and allows petting. Medically, Bubbles is Apparently Healthy.

Bubbles arrived at MACC as a stray. While in care, he has been observed to be highly rope reactive and reactive on leash when seeing other dogs. In the kennel room, Bubbles will pull hard towards the other dogs and react to them. In the yard, Bubbles will jump up on handlers with a soft body and may know the cue sit.
We recommend an an experienced adult only, single pet home that makes no trips to the dog park.

What my friends at ACC say about me:

My history is a mystery and my friends here do not know much about me yet!

I am not one to sit still! I will flourish in a home with someone that will keep me mentally and physically active!

I will need appropriate toys and positive outlets for my energy.
dog.name: Bubbles
